description: Every loaded year of the regency or city minimum wage (UMK) for one kabupaten/kota, oldest first, each row with its source instrument and URL: a governor decree, or for some regions the open-data portal of the regional government (source_instrument then starts with Portal and notes that the dataset has no decree number). Covers Jawa Barat 2023 to 2026, Jawa Tengah 2022 to 2026, Jawa Timur 2024 to 2026, a few Riau and Bali regions for 2024, Kalimantan Barat (2019, 2022, 2025), Banten (2020 to 2024), seven Sumatera Selatan regions (2024), five Kalimantan Timur regions (Berau, Kutai Barat, Kutai Timur, Penajam Paser Utara, Samarinda), six Magelang-area regions 2014 to 2020, Kota Tegal 2021 and Rembang (2010, 2019). Where no decree or portal row exists, BPS provincial tables fill in (source_instrument then starts with BPS table, one amount per year, no decree number or effective date): Sumatera Utara 2015 to 2024, Kepulauan Riau 2016 to 2025, Jawa Tengah 2017 to 2021, Banten 2014 to 2019, Nusa Tenggara Timur 2016 to 2025 (not 2019), Lampung 2017 to 2025, DI Yogyakarta 2016 to 2025, plus UMK 2026 for Nusa Tenggara Timur and 12 Lampung regions.
